description: Intra-forest trust between domains (parent-child or cross-link); Kerberos flows across it.

telemetry.detail: Cross-domain Kerberos referrals (TGS to the trusted domain's krbtgt) are normal traffic.
Intra-forest trust traversal is routine; abuse (e.g. inter-realm golden/trust-key tickets) is the loud part, scored via those edges.

prerequisite_privilege: None to traverse the trust itself
abuse_primitive: Move across the trust with existing tickets; escalate via trust-key or SIDHistory where applicable.
notes: Structural traversal edge kept low. Trust-key abuse and inter-realm ticket forging are separate, louder actions.
